Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing provisions relating to dispute resolution and registration in manufactured and mobile home communities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to dispute resolution and registration inmanufactured and mobile home communities; creating a new section; andrepealing RCW 59.30.010, 59.30.020, 59.30.030, 59.30.040, 59.30.050,59.30.060, 59.30.070, and 59.30.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that: (1) The office of civil legal aid has a fiscal year 20082009biennial budget total of twentytwo million four hundred seventysixthousand dollars to provide state funded civil legal aid to lowincomeindividuals and families throughout the state. (2) The attorney general manages the largest public law office inthe state with more than one thousand two hundred employees and officesin twelve cities around the state, and the office of the attorneygeneral's consumer protection act division already provides a forum foreach resident to file a complaint. (3) The Northwest justice project has over ninety attorneysproviding free legal aid to qualified lowincome tenants in ten officesacross the state. p. 1 HB 1352 (4) Many more federal, state, and local agencies across the stateprovide aid and information for tenants seeking help. (5) Many residents have indicated a desire to not participate inthe attorney general's dispute resolution program. (6) After advertising their services to every community and eachtenant across the state, through September 2008, the attorney general'sdispute resolution program has received six hundred fortyfive thousandone hundred thirtysix dollars to process three hundred ninetyeightcomplaints, an extremely small number given the number of tenants incommunities statewide. The vast majority of these complaints eitherhad nothing to do with the manufactured/mobile home landlordtenantact, or were solved without formal investigation.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 59.30.010 (FindingsPurposeIntent) and 2007 c 431 s 1; RCW 59.30.020 (Definitions) and 2007 c 431 s 2; RCW 59.30.030 (Dispute resolution programPurposeAttorneygeneral duties) and 2007 c 431 s 3; RCW 59.30.040 (Dispute resolution programComplaint process)and 2007 c 431 s 4; RCW 59.30.050 (Registration process, fees) and 2007 c 431 s 6; RCW 59.30.060 (Database) and 2007 c 431 s 7; RCW 59.30.070 (Manufactured/mobile home dispute resolutionprogram account) and 2007 c 431 s 8; and RCW 59.30.080 (Immunity from suit) and 2007 c 431 s 5.
